# SippitySup

> > A culinary and wine publication featuring recipes, wine reviews, and food writing by Greg Henry and Ken Eskenazi, with a focus on seasonal cooking and thoughtful wine pairings.

SippitySup showcases original recipes ranging from seasonal dishes to holiday specialties, alongside wine reviews covering regions from Italy and France to California and Mexico. The site blends practical cooking guides with wine education and pairing recommendations for home cooks and wine enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Greg Henry
- Ken Eskenazi
- Wine reviews and pairings
- Seasonal cooking
- Italian cuisine
- Thanksgiving recipes
- Sparkling wine and Prosecco
- Southern California dining
- Wine regions (Italy, France, Spain, Mexico)
- Bread pudding and desserts
- Savory tarts and pies
- Seafood preparation
- Cocktail recipes

## Recipe Guides & Techniques

- [Alaska Seafood: How to Grill Wild-Caught Halibut](https://www.sippitysup.com/alaska-seafood-how-to-grill-wild-caught-halibut): Grilling guide for wild-caught Alaska halibut with brining technique
- [What is Salsa Verde in Italian?](https://www.sippitysup.com/what-is-salsa-verde-in-italian): Italian salsa verde recipe guide with herbs, capers, and lemon

## Seasonal Recipes & Holiday Cooking

- [Bourbon Bread Pudding: An Ending to my Practice Thanksgiving](https://www.sippitysup.com/bourbon-bread-pudding): Bourbon bread pudding recipe for Thanksgiving dessert by Greg Henry
- [Winter Ice Cream with Maple, Cinnamon and Cranberries](https://www.sippitysup.com/winter-ice-cream): Winter ice cream recipe with maple syrup and cranberries by Greg Henry
- [Roast Carrot & Chestnut Soup: Baby It's Cold Outside (Somewhere)](https://www.sippitysup.com/roast-carrot-chestnut-soup-baby-its-cold-outside-somewhere): Winter roasted carrot and chestnut soup recipe by Greg Henry
- [Carrot Tart in a Glaze of Glory](https://www.sippitysup.com/carrot-tart-in-a-glaze-of-glory): Savory carrot tart recipe for Thanksgiving by Greg Henry
- [Sweet Tooth Mushrooms in a Savoy Cabbage Salad](https://www.sippitysup.com/sweet-tooth-mushrooms-savoy-cabbage-salad): Winter salad with sweet tooth mushrooms and savoy cabbage by Greg Henry

## Everyday Recipes & Quick Dishes

- [Spicy Vietnamese Shrimp. Now. Right Now.](https://www.sippitysup.com/spicy-vietnamese-shrimp-now-right-now): Quick spicy Vietnamese shrimp recipe by Greg Henry
- [A Rustic Flat Tart You Might Call Blueberry Pizza](https://www.sippitysup.com/a-rustic-flat-tart-you-might-call-blueberry-pizza): Rustic blueberry tart recipe with short pastry by Greg Henry
- [Sauteed Mushrooms with Toasted Flatbread and Baked Eggs](https://www.sippitysup.com/sauteed-mushrooms-toasted-flatbread-baked-eggs): Sauteed shiitake mushrooms with flatbread and baked eggs recipe
- [Market Matters- March Mung Madness](https://www.sippitysup.com/market-matters-march-mung-madness): Sesame mung beans salad recipe with cranberries and walnuts

## Wine Reviews & Pairings

- [Galda Brut NV](https://www.sippitysup.com/galda-brut-nv): Wine review of Galda Brut NV Cava sparkling wine for Thanksgiving
- [Locations I-1 Italian Red Wine](https://www.sippitysup.com/locations-1-italian-red-wine): Italian red wine review featuring Negroamaro, Nero d'Avola, Barbera blend
- [2012 Château Petit Roubié Picpoul de Pinet](https://www.sippitysup.com/2012-chateau-petit-roubie-picpoul-de-pinet): Wine review of Picpoul de Pinet from Languedoc, France by Ken Eskenazi
- [Nino Franco "Rustico" Prosecco di Valdobbiadene](https://www.sippitysup.com/nino-franco-rustico-prosecco-di-valdobbiadene): Prosecco wine review of Nino Franco Rustico from Valdobbiadene
- [Learning to Love Wine- Decanting American Varietals](https://www.sippitysup.com/learning-love-wine-decanting-american-varietals): Wine education series on decanting American varietals by Ken Eskenazi
- [Drago and La Stella Pair for a Stellar Meal](https://www.sippitysup.com/drago-and-la-stella-pair-stellar-meal): Wine pairing dinner review at Drago Centro with La Stella Winery

## Cocktails & Beverages

- [King or Kamikaze, Basil Lillet Cocktail Rules](https://www.sippitysup.com/king-or-kamikaze-basil-lillet-cocktail-rules): Basil Lillet cocktail recipe, summer gin drink by Greg Henry
